**Primary page:** [nodejs/node release v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0) — “2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current),” released by RafaelGSS (with @marco-ippolito), signed tag `v22.0.0` at commit `12fb157`. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

At release it was the Current line for six months and was expected to enter LTS in October. Headline items: `require()` of synchronous ESM graphs, WebSocket client enabled by default, V8 12.4.254.14, stable `watch` mode, and Maglev on supported architectures. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

Notable changes called out on the page:
- **esm:** drop import assertions (#52104)
- **lib:** faster AbortSignal creation (#52408); WebSocket on by default (#51594)
- **watch:** stable (#52074)
- **deps:** V8 12.4.254.14 (#52465)
- **stream:** higher default `highWaterMark` (#52037)
- **v8:** Maglev enabled where supported (#51360)
- **cli:** `node --run` for package.json scripts (#52190)
- **fs:** `glob` / `globSync` (#51912)
- **module:** `require()` of synchronous ESM graphs (#51977)

Also listed as semver-major: C++20 on Windows, runtime deprecation of the `Hmac`/`Hash` constructors, and `createCipher` / `createDecipher` moved to end-of-life. [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)
